parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘pyromania’.

parts.text:
Describe the study by Glover (2011) that used covert sensitisation as a treatment for
kleptomania.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Glover.

parts.text: Describe explanations of depression.

Evaluate explanations of depression, including a discussion about reductionism versus

Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify two shopper movement patterns from the study by Gil et al. (2009).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Dayan and Bar‑Hillel (2011) conducted a laboratory study and a field study on primacy,
recency and menu item position.
Outline any two results from these studies by Dayan and Bar‑Hillel.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Discuss the validity of these studies by Dayan and Bar‑Hillel.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about retail/leisure environment design (retail
store architecture, leisure environments, store interior layout).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about retail/leisure environment design (retail
store architecture, leisure environments, store interior layout), including a discussion about
generalisability. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Practitioners may make type I or type II errors in diagnosis.
Outline one of these types of error, including an example in your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the procedure of the study by Robinson and West (1992) on disclosure of information
to a practitioner.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two weaknesses of the study by Robinson and West.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the study by Oldham and Brass (1979) on open plan offices.
